title: Questions, Answered
seo_title: Dog Bed FAQ: Sizing, Washing, Trial & Delivery | PawLunova
seo_description: Worried they won't use it, or it won't fit? Our dog bed FAQ answers sizing, foam, washing, delivery and the 100-night trial plainly. Find your answer.
body_html:
Nearly every question in this dog bed FAQ comes back to one worry: you'll spend the money and they'll go back to the floor. So the answers here take the doubts in the order they usually arrive, from which bed and what size, through foam and washing, to delivery, the trial and the guarantee.

Dog bed FAQ: straight answers, exceptions included

Every answer uses the same terms as our product pages, and where a product is an exception, such as an outdoor dog house or a personalised bed, we say so. For measuring, start with the size guide; for returns, the 100-night trial page; and if your question isn't here, ask us.

If the real question is simply “which one?”, the Bed Finder narrows it to one bed in four questions.
claims_to_confirm: [CONFIRM] How a trial return works for UK addresses off the mainland (Northern Ireland, Highlands and Islands, Isle of Man, Scilly, Channel Islands). The data only says 'free UK mainland collection'; the FAQ tells those customers to ask before ordering.
[CONFIRM] What the 5-year no-flatten guarantee provides if a core does flatten (replacement core, replacement bed, repair?). The data gives scope and exclusions only, so no remedy is stated.
[CONFIRM] Whether the 100-night trial applies to the Whinlatter car seat. Its description says 'check the returns terms and confirm eligibility', so the FAQ lists it as a check-first exception.
